fields.name: id
fields.semantics: mesh region index 0..numRegions-1

fields.name: lat
fields.semantics: asin(y)*180/PI — Y-up convention, js/wind.js:571

fields.name: lon
fields.semantics: atan2(x,z)*180/PI — Y-up convention, js/wind.js:572

fields.name: isSyntheticPole
fields.semantics: The artificial vertex appended by buildSphere (js/sphere-mesh.js:178-184) at (0,0,1) to close the Fibonacci mesh. It reads as lat 0 / lon 0. Its Voronoi cell, neighbour ring, cellArea_km2 and isSurfaceCoast are mesh artefacts, not terrain. Filter this out before any spatial analysis.

fields.name: elev
fields.semantics: final elevation; >0 is land

fields.name: elev_km
fields.semantics: canonical generator curve: ocean elev*10; land 6*t^4*(5-4t) (js/color-map.js:7-12)

fields.name: prePost
fields.semantics: elevation snapshot taken BEFORE the whole post-processing block (warp, smoothing, detail noise, erosion, soil creep)

fields.name: postProcessDelta
fields.semantics: elev - prePost: the FULL post-processing delta INCLUDING terrain warp. Contrast with the erosionDelta debug layer, whose baseline is snapshotted AFTER the warp (js/planet-worker.js:78-88), so erosionDelta EXCLUDES warp.

fields.name: cellArea_km2
fields.semantics: spherical Voronoi cell area (Van Oosterom-Strackee over the incident-triangle ring), scaled by R = 6371 km — the radius the codebase itself assumes (js/terrain-metrics.js:19). Rescale if your planet is not Earth-sized.

fields.name: isLand
fields.semantics: r_elevation > 0

fields.name: isMountain
fields.semantics: tectonic mountain class (js/elevation.js:230-235)

fields.name: isTectCoastal
fields.semantics: TECTONIC boundary class (js/elevation.js:227-236) — this is the old CSV `isCoastal`. It is NOT a land/ocean coastline; use isSurfaceCoast for that.

fields.name: isSurfaceCoast
fields.semantics: TRUE coastline: this cell has at least one neighbour on the other side of sea level

fields.name: isOceanRegion
fields.semantics: tectonic ocean-boundary class

fields.name: plate
fields.semantics: COARSE-MESH SEED REGION ID, not a dense 0..P-1 index. Join against orogen_plates.csv.

fields.name: isOcPlate
fields.semantics: current oceanic/continental flag of this cell's plate

fields.name: origIsOcPlate
fields.semantics: flag as first generated, before any user plate toggle

fields.name: stress
fields.semantics: plate-boundary stress magnitude

fields.name: eastX
fields.semantics: local east unit vector, x

fields.name: eastY
fields.semantics: local east unit vector, y — identically 0 under the Y-up convention

fields.name: eastZ
fields.semantics: local east unit vector, z

fields.name: northX
fields.semantics: local north unit vector, x

fields.name: northY
fields.semantics: local north unit vector, y

fields.name: northZ
fields.semantics: local north unit vector, z

fields.name: backArc
fields.semantics: back-arc basin contribution

fields.name: base
fields.semantics: raw distance-field elevation before any per-domain modifier

fields.name: basin
fields.semantics: shield <-> basin personality field; LAND ONLY

fields.name: coastal
fields.semantics: coastal-plain suppression + coastal detail + island-arc uplift; mixed sign

fields.name: continentality
fields.semantics: smoothstep of BFS distance-from-ocean, elevation mask

fields.name: erosionDelta
fields.semantics: final minus the post-WARP snapshot (js/planet-worker.js:88,154-157). EXCLUDES terrain warp; use postProcessDelta for warp + everything.

fields.name: foldRidge
fields.semantics: generator debug layer (see js/elevation.js / js/planet-worker.js)

fields.name: hotspot
fields.semantics: hotspot / plume uplift field

fields.name: interior
fields.semantics: continental-interior bias and plateau boost; LAND ONLY, 0 on ocean

fields.name: koppen
fields.semantics: CATEGORICAL index into KOPPEN_CLASSES; 0 = Ocean. See orogen_koppen_classes.csv.

fields.name: margins
fields.semantics: CATEGORICAL, ocean only: 0.2 passive margin, 0.8 active margin, 1.0 mid-ocean ridge, -0.5 fracture zone (js/elevation.js:1174-1177)

fields.name: noise
fields.semantics: delta added by the noise block

fields.name: ocean
fields.semantics: ocean-floor shelf/slope/abyss profile; OCEAN ONLY

fields.name: orogenicPower
fields.semantics: shaped low-frequency noise STORED AS raw-0.5, so its range is centred on zero (js/elevation.js:929)

fields.name: pressureSummer
fields.semantics: sea-level pressure DEVIATION from 1013 hPa (js/wind.js:850-853)

fields.name: pressureWinter
fields.semantics: sea-level pressure DEVIATION from 1013 hPa (js/wind.js:850-853)

fields.name: rainShadowSummer
fields.semantics: orographic rain-shadow factor, NH summer

fields.name: rainShadowWinter
fields.semantics: orographic rain-shadow factor, NH winter

fields.name: tecActivity
fields.semantics: max(normalised stress, cubed proximity to mountain seeds)

fields.name: tectonic
fields.semantics: delta added by the tectonic-uplift block

fields.name: windSpeedSummer
fields.semantics: p95-normalised AND CLAMPED (js/wind.js:842-846). Use windS_Speed_raw for the true magnitude.

fields.name: windSpeedWinter
fields.semantics: p95-normalised AND CLAMPED (js/wind.js:842-846). Use windW_Speed_raw for the true magnitude.

fields.name: superPlate
fields.semantics: CATEGORICAL super-plate group id 0..numSuperPlates-1; nominal, not ordered. Renumbered from scratch by any plate-edit rebuild (js/planet-worker.js:598-601).

fields.name: koppen_code
fields.semantics: e.g. Af, BWh, Cfb; "Ocean" for class 0. Full table in orogen_koppen_classes.csv.

fields.name: tS
fields.semantics: normalised NH-summer temperature; CLAMPED to [0,1] at js/temperature.js:997

fields.name: tW
fields.semantics: normalised NH-winter temperature; CLAMPED to [0,1] at js/temperature.js:997

fields.name: tempC_S
fields.semantics: -45 + t*90. Because t is clamped, +-45 C are SATURATED, not measured — see tS_sat.

fields.name: tempC_W
fields.semantics: -45 + t*90. Because t is clamped, +-45 C are SATURATED, not measured — see tW_sat.

fields.name: tS_sat
fields.semantics: -1 = floored at -45 C, +1 = ceilinged at +45 C, 0 = in range

fields.name: tW_sat
fields.semantics: -1 = floored at -45 C, +1 = ceilinged at +45 C, 0 = in range

fields.name: pS
fields.semantics: p95-clamped, then interior-capped, then contrast-stretched. CAN EXCEED 1.0.

fields.name: pW
fields.semantics: p95-clamped, then interior-capped, then contrast-stretched. CAN EXCEED 1.0.

fields.name: precipMM_S
fields.semantics: pS * KOPPEN_PRECIP_SCALE_MM. This is EXACTLY what the Koppen classifier saw (js/koppen.js:110-111 multiplies the same post-contrast value).

fields.name: precipMM_W
fields.semantics: pW * KOPPEN_PRECIP_SCALE_MM — exactly what the Koppen classifier saw.

fields.name: pS_p95units
fields.semantics: summer precip with the seasonal-contrast stretch removed; this is the scientifically comparable field

fields.name: pW_p95units
fields.semantics: winter precip with the seasonal-contrast stretch removed

fields.name: pS_censored
fields.semantics: pre-contrast summer value sits at the p95 ceiling. SOUND but not COMPLETE: the continental interior cap (js/precipitation.js:731-739) can pull a clamped cell below the ceiling and hide it. Empty where precip_invertible = 0.

fields.name: pW_censored
fields.semantics: as pS_censored, for winter

fields.name: precip_invertible
fields.semantics: 0 when the max(0,..) floor in js/precipitation.js:759-761 destroyed mean-preservation for this cell (either season exactly 0), or when PRECIP_SEASON_CONTRAST was unreadable

fields.name: windS_E
fields.semantics: NH-summer wind, eastward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: windS_N
fields.semantics: NH-summer wind, northward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: windS_Speed_raw
fields.semantics: NH-summer wind, TRUE uncensored magnitude hypot(E,N). The app only ever displays min(1, hypot/p95).

fields.name: windW_E
fields.semantics: NH-winter wind, eastward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: windW_N
fields.semantics: NH-winter wind, northward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: windW_Speed_raw
fields.semantics: NH-winter wind, TRUE uncensored magnitude hypot(E,N). The app only ever displays min(1, hypot/p95).

fields.name: ocS_E
fields.semantics: NH-summer ocean current, eastward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: ocS_N
fields.semantics: NH-summer ocean current, northward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: ocS_Speed_raw
fields.semantics: NH-summer ocean current, TRUE uncensored magnitude hypot(E,N). The app only ever displays min(1, hypot/p95).

fields.name: ocW_E
fields.semantics: NH-winter ocean current, eastward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: ocW_N
fields.semantics: NH-winter ocean current, northward component (pre-normalisation)

fields.name: ocW_Speed_raw
fields.semantics: NH-winter ocean current, TRUE uncensored magnitude hypot(E,N). The app only ever displays min(1, hypot/p95).

fields.name: ocSpeedS_norm
fields.semantics: min(1, hypot/p95) as displayed (js/ocean.js:373-376). Multiply by meta.p95.oceanSummer to recover raw units.

fields.name: ocSpeedW_norm
fields.semantics: min(1, hypot/p95) as displayed. Multiply by meta.p95.oceanWinter to recover raw units.

fields.name: owS
fields.semantics: advected ocean warmth, NH summer

fields.name: owW
fields.semantics: advected ocean warmth, NH winter

fieldsMissing: tempContinentality (omitted by the on-demand climate path; set CFG.RERUN_WIND + CFG.RERUN_TEMP to recover)

conversions.temp_C: -45 + t*90. js/temperature.js:997 CLAMPS t to [0,1] with T_MIN=-45/T_MAX=+45 (:789-790), so +-45 C are SATURATED, not measured — see tS_sat / tW_sat (-1 = floored, +1 = ceilinged, 0 = in range).
conversions.precip_mm: p * 1000 (KOPPEN_PRECIP_SCALE_MM). precipMM_S/W reproduce exactly what the Koppen classifier saw (js/koppen.js:110-111 uses the same post-contrast value).
conversions.cellArea_km2: spherical Voronoi cell area x R^2 with R = 6371 km — the radius the codebase itself assumes (js/terrain-metrics.js:19). Rescale for a non-Earth-sized planet.
conversions.wind3D: windS_3D = windS_E*[eastX,eastY,eastZ] + windS_N*[northX,northY,northZ]; same for windW_, ocS_, ocW_. The basis reproduces js/wind.js:578-589 exactly.
conversions.windSpeed_raw: hypot(E, N) — uncensored. The app displays min(1, hypot/p95) (js/wind.js:842-846).
conversions.oceanSpeed_raw: hypot(E, N) — uncensored. The app displays min(1, hypot/p95) (js/ocean.js:365-377).

notes: isTectCoastal is the generator TECTONIC class (the old CSV `isCoastal`, js/elevation.js:227-236), not a coastline. isSurfaceCoast is the TRUE land/ocean adjacency coastline, computed here.
Plate ids are COARSE-mesh seed region ids, not a dense 0..P-1 range.

pS/pW are p95-clamped (js/precipitation.js:721-724), then interior-capped (:731-739), then contrast-stretched by PRECIP_SEASON_CONTRAST=1 (:745-763) — so they CAN EXCEED 1.0. pS_p95units/pW_p95units are the exact pre-contrast values (the stretch preserves the seasonal mean, so it inverts exactly). pS_censored/pW_censored flag cells whose PRE-CONTRAST value hit the p95 ceiling: sound, but not complete, because the continental interior cap can pull a clamped cell back below the ceiling. Cells with precip_invertible = 0 are not recoverable (the max(0,..) floor at :759-761 broke mean-preservation).
The layer once exported as `foldRidge` was renamed `phasorRidge` upstream and is emitted under that name. `superPlates` is emitted as the integer column `superPlate`.

tempSummer/tempWinter/precipSummer/precipWinter in debugLayers are the SAME ARRAY OBJECTS as r_temperature_summer/winter and r_precip_summer/winter (js/planet-worker.js:369-371, 776-778); they are emitted once each, under the short names tS/tW/pS/pW. See aliasedLayers.

tempContinentality is omitted by the on-demand climate path (js/planet-worker.js:767-780) and therefore only exists on planets small enough for climate at generation time (AUTO_CLIMATE_THRESHOLD = 300000, js/main.js:83). Set CFG.RERUN_WIND + CFG.RERUN_TEMP to recover it.

coastDistLand, westness and plateContinentality are returned by computeWind (js/wind.js:884-886) but never forwarded by buildClimateFields (js/planet-worker.js:171-193), so they exist in NO stored field. Set CFG.RERUN_WIND to recover them.

Region 2560000 is the synthetic vertex appended by buildSphere (js/sphere-mesh.js:178-184) at (0,0,1) to close the Fibonacci mesh. Under lat=asin(y)/lon=atan2(x,z) it reports lat 0, lon 0. Its Voronoi cell, neighbour ring, cellArea_km2 and isSurfaceCoast are mesh artefacts, not terrain. Filter isSyntheticPole = 1 before any spatial analysis.

plateEditDetected = true: the five plate-physics layers were destroyed by a plate-edit rebuild (editDone replaces curData.debugLayers wholesale) and superPlate ids were renumbered by buildSuperPlates. Regenerate the planet from its code and export BEFORE editing to capture them.
ITCZ curves are a 360-bin RESAMPLING at bin centres over [-pi, pi) (js/wind.js:863-875) of a spline fitted at only NUM_LON = 72 longitudes (js/wind.js:235) — 360 is not the native resolution.
terrainMetricsNote: window.__terrainMetrics is written ONLY on the initial `done` message (js/generate.js:243) and is never refreshed by reapplyDone or editDone, so terrainMetricsAtGeneration describes the planet AS FIRST GENERATED and can be stale after any Reapply or plate edit. terrainMetricsFresh is non-null only when CFG.RECOMPUTE_TERRAIN_METRICS was on; it is recomputed against the CURRENT r_elevation using a COPY of plateIsOcean, because computeTerrainMetrics writes back onto the context object it is given (js/terrain-metrics.js:802-805) and passing curData directly would corrupt the live app. Keys beginning with _ are dropped by computeTerrainMetrics itself and are not recoverable.
climateParamsNote: js/climate-config.js:153 exports CLIMATE = {...CLIMATE_DEFAULTS} — a live, mutable object every climate module reads at call time. Without it the exported climate columns cannot be reproduced or fully interpreted (PRECIP_MODEL_BLEND, PRECIP_CONT_CAP_*, PRECIP_SEASON_CONTRAST, TEMP_SWING_SCALE, KOPPEN_SHOULDER_FRAC, the WIND_ITCZ_* family all shape these numbers).

p95._note: p95 = hypot(E,N)/normalisedSpeed, solved on uncensored cells; `spread` should be ~1e-3 if the solve is sound. Multiply any *Speed_norm column by p95 to recover raw units. `precip` is null because the pre-normalisation precipitation array is overwritten IN PLACE (js/precipitation.js:721-724) and its p95 is not solvable from stored state.

dualMesh.orogen_triangles_xyz_elev.f32: Float32 [x,y,z,elev] * numTriangles, little-endian. xyz is the UNNORMALISED arithmetic centroid of the three corner unit vectors (js/sphere-mesh.js:206-218) — normalise before using it as a direction. elev is curData.t_elevation, the mean of the three corner region elevations (NaN if t_elevation was unavailable).
dualMesh.orogen_mesh_triangles: three region ids per triangle, row-major (the Delaunay index)
dualMesh.orogen_mesh_halfedges: opposite-side index per side, -1 where unpaired
